translations.web: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
translations.bsb: They were especially grieved by his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
translations.kjv: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.
translations.asv: sorrowing most of all for the word which he had spoken, that they should behold his face no more. And they brought him on his way unto the ship.
